cnd21:1.1: “idamavoca bhagavā magadhesu viharanto pāsāṇake cetiye paricārakasoḷasānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ ajjhiṭṭho puṭṭho pañhaṃ byākāsi.”
cnd21:2.4: magadhesu viharanto pāsāṇake cetiyeti ‘magadhesū’ti magadhanāmake janapade viharantoti caranto viharanto irīyanto vattento pālento yapento yāpento.
cnd21:2.7: paricāraka soḷasānaṃ brāhmaṇānanti piṅgiyo brāhmaṇo bāvarissa brāhmaṇassa paddho paddhacaro paricārako sisso.
cnd21:2.10: athavā te soḷasabrāhmaṇā buddhassa bhagavato paddhā paddhacarā paricārikā sissāti
cnd21:3.3: puṭṭho puṭṭhoti puṭṭho puṭṭho pucchito pucchito yācito yācito ajjhesito ajjhesito pasādito pasādito.
cnd21:3.4: pañhaṃ byākāsīti pañhaṃ byākāsi ācikkha desehi paññapesi paṭṭhapesi vivari vibhaji uttānīakāsi pakāsesīti
cnd21:4.1: “idamavoca bhagavā magadhesu viharanto pāsāṇake cetiye paricārikasoḷasānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ ajjhiṭṭho puṭṭho puṭṭho pañhaṃ byākāsī”ti.
cnd21:5.1: “ekamekassa cepi pañhassa atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjeyya, gaccheyyeva jarāmaraṇassa paraṃ
cnd21:6.1: ekamekassa cepi pañhassāti: ekamekassa cepi ajita pañhassa, ekamekassa cepi tissametteyyapañhassa. ekamekassa cepi puṇṇakapañhassa, ekamekassa cepi mettagupañhassa, ekamekassa cepi dhotakapañhassa, ekamekassa cepi upasivapañhassa, ekamekassa cepi nandakapañhassa, ekamekassa cepi hemakapañhassa, ekamekassa cepi todeyyapañhassa, ekamekassa cepi kappapañhassa, ekamekassa cepi jatukaṇṇipañhassa, ekamekassa cepi bhadrāvudhapañhassa, ekamekassa cepi udayapañhassa, ekamekassa cepi posālapañhassa, ekamekassa cepi mogharājapañhassa ekamekassa cepi piṅgiyapañhassāti
cnd21:7.1: atthamaññāya dhammamaññāyāti: sveva pañho dhammo, vissajjanaṃ attho, atthamaññāyāti atthaṃ aññāya jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvāti
cnd21:7.3: dhammamaññāyāti dhammaṃ aññāya jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvāti
cnd21:7.6: dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjeyyāti: sammāpaṭipadaṃ anulomapaṭipadaṃ apaccanīkapaṭipadaṃ anvatthapaṭipadaṃ dhammānudhammapaṭipadaṃ paṭipajjeyyāti
cnd21:7.8: gaccheyyeva jarāmaraṇassa pāranti: jarāmaraṇassa pāraṃ vuccati amataṃ nibbānaṃ
cnd21:7.9: “yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ”
cnd21:7.10: gaccheyyeva jarāmaraṇassa pāranti jarāmaraṇassa pāraṃ gaccheyya, pāraṃ adhigaccheyaṃ pāraṃ adhiphasseyya, pāraṃ sacchikareyyāti
cnd21:7.12: pāraṃ gamaniyā ime dhammāti: ime dhammā pāraṃ gamaniyā
cnd21:7.13: pāraṃ pāpenti pāraṃ saṃpāpenti pāraṃ samanupāpenti jarāmaraṇassa taraṇāya saṃvattantīti
cnd21:8.6: pārāyanaṃ tveva adhivacananti ‘pāraṃ’ vuccati amataṃ …pe… nirodho nibbānaṃ,
cnd21:8.9: adhivacananti saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti byañjanaṃ abhilāpoti
cnd21:9.1: “ekamekassa cepi pañhassa atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjeyya gaccheyyeva jarāmaraṇassa pāraṃ
cnd21:9.3: tasmā imassa dhammapariyāyassa pārāyanaṃ tveva adhivacananti’.
cnd21:13.3: buddhoti “yo so bhagavā sayambhū anācariyako pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhi, tattha ca sabbaññutaṃ patto balesu ca vasībhāvaṃ.
cnd21:13.5: bujjhitā saccānīti buddho, bodhetā pajāyāti buddho, sabbaññutāya buddho, sabbadassāvitāya buddho, anaññaneyyatāya buddho, visavitāya buddho, khīṇāsavasaṅkhātena buddho, nirupakkilesasaṅkhātena buddho, ekantavītarāgoti buddho ekantavītadosoti buddho, ekantavītamohoti buddho, ekantanikkilesoti buddho ekāyanamaggaṃ gatoti, buddho eko anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti buddho. abuddhivihatattā buddhipaṭilābhāti buddho.
cnd21:13.6: buddhoti netaṃ nāmaṃ mātarā kataṃ, na pitarā kataṃ na bhātarā kataṃ, na bhaginiyā kataṃ, na mittāmaccehi kataṃ, na ñātisālohitehi kataṃ, na samaṇabrāhmaṇehi kataṃ, na devatāhi kataṃ,
cnd21:13.7: vimokkhantikametaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ bodhiyā mūle saha sabbaññutañāṇassa paṭilābhā sacchikāpaññatti yadidaṃ buddhoti.
cnd21:13.8: ete buddhaṃ upāgañchunti ete buddhaṃ upāgamiṃsu, upasaṅkamiṃsu, payirupāsiṃsu, paripucchiṃsu: paripañhiṃsūti
cnd21:14.2: sīlasaṃvaropi caraṇaṃ, indriyasaṃvaropi caraṇaṃ, bhojane mattaññutāpi caraṇaṃ, jāgariyānuyogopi caraṇaṃ, sattapi saddhammā caraṇaṃ cattāripi jhānāni caraṇaṃ,
cnd21:14.3: sampannacaraṇanti: sampannacaraṇaṃ seṭṭhacaraṇaṃ viseṭṭhacaraṇaṃ pāmokkhacaraṇaṃ uttamacaraṇaṃ pavaracaraṇaṃ.
cnd21:14.4: isīti: isi bhagavā: mahantaṃ sīlakkhandhaṃ esi gavesi pariyesīti isi …pe… mahesakkhehi vā sattehi esito gavesito, pariyesito
cnd21:14.5: ‘kahaṃ buddho kahaṃ bhagavā kahaṃ devadevo kahaṃ narāsabhoti
cnd21:15.3: nipuṇe pañheti: gambhīre duddase duranubodhe sante paṇīte atakkāvacare nipuṇe paṇḍitavedanīye pañheti
cnd21:16.3: seṭṭhanti: aggaṃ seṭṭhaṃ viseṭṭhaṃ pāmokkhaṃ uttamaṃ pavaraṃ buddhaseṭṭhaṃ. upāgamunti: upāgamiṃsu upasaṅkamiṃsu payirupāsiṃsu paripucchiṃsu paripañhiṃsūti
cnd21:19.3: buddhoti: “yo so bhagavā …pe… sacchikāpaññatti yadidaṃ buddho”ti.
cnd21:19.4: byākāsīti tesaṃ buddho byākāsi ācikkhi desesi paññapesi paṭṭhapesi vivari vibhaji uttānī akāsi pakāsesīti
cnd21:20.2: ‘pañhe puṭṭho’ti pañhe puṭṭho pucchito yācito ajjhesito pasādito.
cnd21:20.3: yathātathanti: yathā ācikkhitabbaṃ tathā ācikkhi, yathā desitabbaṃ tathā desesi, yathā paññāpetabbaṃ tathā paññāpesi, yathā paṭṭhapetabbaṃ tathā paṭṭhapesi, yathā vivaritabbaṃ tathā vivari, yathā vibhajitabbaṃ tathā vibhaji, yathā uttānīkātabbaṃ tathā uttānīakāsi, yathā pakāsitabbaṃ tathā pakāsesīti
cnd21:21.1: pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇenāti: pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena ācikkhanena desanena paññāpanena paṭṭhapanena vivaraṇena vibhajanena uttānīkammena pakāsanenāti
cnd21:22.2: ‘tosesī’ti tosesi vitosesi pasādesi ārādhesi attamane akāsi.
cnd21:22.4: munīti ‘monaṃ’ vuccati ñāṇaṃ …pe… saṅgajālamaticca so munīti
cnd21:25.3: tositāti tositā vitositā pasāditā ārādhitā attamanā katāti
cnd21:26.2: ‘buddho’ti yo so bhagavā …pe… sacchikā paññatti yadidaṃ buddhoti.
cnd21:26.4: so gotamo gottena bhagavāpi gotamo gottena, bhagavā suriyassa gottañātako gottabandhu,
cnd21:27.1: brahmacariyamacariṃsūti ‘brahmacariyaṃ’ vuccati asaddhammasamāpattiyā ārati virati paṭivirati veramaṇī viramaṇā akiriyā akaraṇaṃ anajjhāpatti velāanatikkamo setughāto.
cnd21:27.2: apica nippariyāya vasena brahmacariyā vuccati ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathīdaṃ
cnd21:27.3: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṃkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
cnd21:28.1: varapaññassa santiketi: varapaññassa aggapaññassa seṭṭhapaññassa viseṭṭhapaññassa pāmokkhapaññassa uttamapaññassa pavarapaññassa.
cnd21:28.2: santiketi: santike sāmantā āsanne avidūre upakaṭṭheti
cnd21:31.1: ekamekassa pañhassāti: ekamekassa ajitapañhassa, ekamekassa tissametteyya pañhassa. ekamekassa …pe…
cnd21:32.4: yathā buddhena desitanti: yathā buddhena ācikkhitaṃ desitaṃ paññapitaṃ paṭṭhapitaṃ vivaritaṃ vibhajitaṃ uttānīkataṃ pakāsitanti
cnd21:33.1: tathā yo paṭipajjeyyāti: sammāpaṭipadaṃ anulomapaṭipadaṃ apaccanīkapaṭipadaṃ anvatthapaṭipadaṃ dhammānudhammapaṭipadaṃ paṭipajjeyyāti
cnd21:34.1: gacche pāraṃ apāratoti: pāraṃ vuccati amataṃ …pe… nirodho nibbānaṃ.
cnd21:34.2: ‘apāraṃ’ vuccati kilesā ca khandhā ca abhisaṅkhārā ca.
cnd21:34.3: gacche pāraṃ apāratoti: apārato pāraṃ gaccheyya pāraṃ adhigaccheyya pāraṃ phasseyya pāraṃ sacchikareyyāti
cnd21:37.1: apārā pāraṃ gaccheyyāti: ‘apāraṃ’ vuccati kilesā ca khandhā ca abhisaṅkhārā ca
cnd21:37.4: apārā pāraṃ gaccheyyāti: apārā pāraṃ gaccheyya, pāraṃ adhigaccheyya, pāraṃ phasseyya, pāraṃ sacchikareyyāti
cnd21:38.1: bhāvento maggamuttamanti: ‘maggamuttamaṃ’ vuccati ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathīdaṃ:
cnd21:38.3: maggamuttamanti: maggaṃ aggaṃ seṭṭhaṃ viseṭṭhaṃ pāmokkhaṃ uttamaṃ pavaraṃ.
cnd21:41.1: pāraṃ gamanāyāti: pāraṃ gamanāya pāraṃ sampāpanāya pāraṃ samanupāpanāya jarāmaraṇassa taraṇāyāti
